rows.adds-colourless-mana-equal-to-the-counte: Oracle: at the beginning of your next main phase, add {C} equal to the countered spell's mana value (CR 603.7, 106.1b, 202.3). Observed: after Mana Drain counters Grizzly Bears (mana value 2), the delayed trigger adds no mana at p1's next precombat main phase; after the delayed trigger resolves (the scenario's resolve step) p1's pool is still empty. Corroborated: XMage (4142596) and Forge (build ae39d91530) both show the delayed trigger on the stack at that main phase and p1 holding {C}{C} after it resolves.
